digest.component_or_area: agent skills documentation and workflow guidance
propositions: Implementation skill must require atomic rebar claim for starting work instead of offering direct rebar transition as alternative
Claim command should omit explicit assignee by default, using configured ticket.default_assignee or leaving ticket unassigned
Explicit assignee overrides in Jira-reconciled stores must use email or accountId, never bare handles
Brainstorm skill must distinguish blocked-work current-cycle completion from successful review verdict and document unsigned INDETERMINATE with coverage.llm_ran false and exit status 2
Both skills must retain dependency-order guidance and prohibit agent force
Ticket arid-gutless-myna requires append-only correction comment citing enforced behavior without modifying status, description, or acceptance criteria
